message0: Render tree structure overlay %1 percentage %2 (0 to 1) growth mode %3 y-offset %4 scale %5 spin speed %6 (degrees/sec, 0 = no spin) on shape bounds %7
tooltip: Renders an in-world 3D hologram of a captured tree structure (.nbt, imported via MCreator's Structures panel) scaled to growth percentage (0 to 1). The structure input accepts the structure picker block, a plain text block, or any String-producing variable/expression, so the structure name can be computed/changed programmatically. Uniform scale grows the whole structure evenly; bottom-up reveal shows more of the structure from the ground up as it grows. Spin speed rotates the whole structure around its own center at that many degrees per second (0 disables spinning). Supports shape bounds and Y-offset (pixels).
